statement: Use Hunter for Citric Conflict tower defense because 'Stop Right There' and 'Kung Fu Kick' are needed for crowd control.
Later waves have teleporting mobs; pause them under the Voidinator so all get hit and the game doesn't end early.
Higher construction bench tower levels are better; Poisonic Elder level determines how many waves you clear as main damage dealer.
Other towers you use should be close to max or already maxed.
Getting unused towers (Pulse Mage and Fireball Lobber) above level 50 with the Atom Collider gives extra damage to towers and helps wave clear.
Level the Banked Point stamp for more starting points in tower defense; makes early game easier.
Crab Juice vial in World 2 gives more starting points.
Calcium Carbonate vial gives a lot more worship starting points.

subsystem: Post Office Crate of the Creator
statement: Maxing Crate of the Creator post office box gives an additional 54 starting worship points.

subsystem: Salt Lick tower defense points bonus
statement: Salt Lick bonus for more points earned in Worship tower defense is extremely important to max despite costing many Green Salts.
Maxing the Salt Lick bonus helps you gain more Worship Souls overall.
Cannoli in the World 4 Dinner Menu gives more points earned during tower defense; level it as high as you can.
Higher Cannoli level lets you get farther because you can afford better towers.
Atom Collider Carbon unlock gives +2 maximum levels to all Wizard towers.
Each tower level above 50 gives each tower an additional 2% damage.
Carbon is a very late game thing; don't worry about it if you lack the points.
Have as much movement speed as possible then hit Summon and run down the bridge as fast as possible.
Place a Poisonic Elder as close to the portal as possible first then a Voidinator and a Frozone Malone.
Place a Kraken tower within range of the Void tower or slightly farther back to defend early waves.
Turn on auto attack in early waves since you can do enough damage to kill some early mobs.
Next goal is 2 more Poisonic Elders as quickly as possible plus a Stormcaller between the Poisonic Elders and the Kraken.
You may need to replace your Kraken tower depending on its placement so the full setup sits between portal and first Kraken.
Purple mobs teleport every time they are hit; Krakens must knock them back into Voidinator range or they skip past and damage HP.
Not a concern in early waves but a few waves later there will be 7 or 8 teleporting mobs.
Make sure the Voidinator is disabling the mobs' abilities as fast as possible.
Place Stormcaller butted up close to the others; delete the Kraken between waves to save space and place new towers quickly.
Place the Stormcaller then the Kraken again when you have enough points to replace both; most effective setup though you lose some points.
Next phase: 2 more Kraken towers at end of the line close together and another Stormcaller as the last tower.
Stormcaller towers mainly give more Crit Chance so they are not important early game.
Depending on Poisonic Elder base level it may be worth upgrading towers instead of getting the last tower out.
Place the last Stormcaller by the entrance far enough over so you don't accidentally click the portal when upgrading.
If struggling at this stage do upgrades first.
Upgrade the middle Poisonic Elders first as primary damage dealers; they get stunned frequently early.
Upgrade Poisonic Elders to level 5 and take Trait B as fast as possible for more damage.
Keep killing mobs actively in early waves or your tower takes avoidable damage.
Keep upgrading all 3 Poisonic Elders with Trait B for more Cloud Hit Chance; gives base damage and more ticks.
Next tower is Party Starter; level each up to 5 as soon as placed and select Trait A for attack speed.
Eventually want 7 Party Starter towers; late game setup added periodically.
Add a new Party Starter once upgrades cost more than about half the cost of summoning a new tower.
Select Trait A until you have 10 Trait A total for 250% attack speed then switch to Trait B; which towers hold A doesn't matter.
All towers are in range of the Party Starters except farther ones which may not fully reach Stormcaller.
Next priority: upgrade Stormcallers to level 5 always selecting Trait B for extra Crit Chance.
Crits deal 2x damage so more Crit Chance equals more damage.
Stand back on the ledge when upgrading Stormcaller so you can click off if you click the wrong area.
Stormcaller can add 20% crit on the middle tower and reach a third tower for up to 100% crit between both Stormcallers.
With both Stormcallers a tower has about 40% crit chance giving about 30% more damage overall.
Voidinator upgrade costs about 500-600 points and gives 20% damage to all towers; always take Trait B.
Cheap Frozone Malone upgrade adds 2 seconds of slow on mobs.
Slow lets Poison towers deal more damage and relieves Kraken towers.
Upgrade Kraken towers to level 5 taking Trait B first for 25% farther pushback then Trait A; always B then A.
Upgrade all 3 Krakens for pushback to keep mobs in Voidinator range longer.
Get more Party Starters; each additional adds about 25% attack speed; want 7 by end game.
Recommend getting fourth Party Starter out before trying level 10 upgrades or wave 10.
Be careful with Next Wave Button: ensure no tower is stunned and enough Kraken Eyeballs are up and last wave cleared.
Next Wave Button gives additional points but stunned Voidinator can't handle purple mobs.
Place a Party Starter on the top ledge to stay in range of all towers and upgrade it for attack speed.
Start upgrading towers to level 10 beginning with Party Starters then Poisonic Elders.
Rest of game is upgrading towers and placing 3 additional Party Starters; costs get exorbitant.
Poisonic Elder to level 10 costs about 3k-5k points requiring a few waves per tower.
Level 9 to 10 gives another 300 damage versus 97 damage at level 5; big overall damage boost.
Level 10 Poisonic Elder trait select Trait A so clouds last longer and mitigate stun damage area.
Trait A allows multiple clouds out at once per tower so mobs take damage the entire time in range.
With enough attack speed focus on damage output then upgrade support towers again.
Stay behind Poisonic Elders or Krakens; if you lack HP you can die and reset all waves.
Upgrade Stormcaller to level 10 with Trait B giving all Poisonic Elders 40% crit chance.
Second Stormcaller level 10 gives middle tower about 80% crit; all but last tower have 80% crit roughly doubling damage.
Upgrade Voidinator to level 10 for extra 20% damage.
With spare points upgrade Frozone Malone to level 10 and select Trait A for more slow.
Extra slow keeps Kraken towers efficient longer; duration doesn't matter since it attacks fast.
Summon next Party Starter up top.
Level the Party Starter to level 10 with the last 2 Trait A; 250% attack speed is plenty to get through waves.
Better to place another Party Starter than upgrade to level 15 which costs 4-5K points per tower.
Past Wave 60 he starts placing last 2 towers.
Sixth and seventh Party Starters upgrade to level 10 with Trait B giving 15% damage per trait; ~30% more damage per tower.
At 20K points place another tower up top for additional 30% damage at level 10.
With ridiculous late points place an additional fifth tower at the bottom; usually towers just lack damage by then.
Upgrade Krakens to level 10 choosing the extra Underling option.
Extra Underling gives more pushback keeping mobs in tower range.
Then slowly upgrade towers to level 15; upgrade Poisonic Elders evenly until all level 15 before anything else.
Party Starter to level 15 costs about 7.5K points; worth it when affordable for damage on all towers.
At level 15 choose A B or all B for Party Starters as long as you keep 250% attack speed.
No benefit from towers until they reach next tier; hold points for Poisonic Elders instead of another Party Starter.
If stuck on a slow Boss Wave spend 3K points for another 20% damage on Poisonic Elder.
Increase Poisonic Elders one level at a time across all 3 for more damage per point.
Rest of waves is upgrading towers; some points go to Stormcaller crit for 100% crit on middle tower.
If upgrades cost 10K-20K each summon an extra Party Starter for 30-45% more damage.
Never use Next Wave at this point unless a ~30 second countdown remains; risk stunned or unprepared towers.
Start using Hunter's Stop Right There after Wave 80; stand far back with auto-attack on to use every 30-45 seconds.
Manual use is more effective when mobs pile up.
Use it when purple mobs aren't taken down by the Voidinator to progress past Wave 90.
Whole run takes several hours; Wave 90 takes about 50 minutes depending on tower levels.
Upgrade towers as much as possible in last waves; get at least 1 tower to level 15 if you can.
Level 15 gives an additional tick so mobs die quicker.
Hold points to make best decision when the boss appears.
At level 15 Poisonic Elder pick Trait B for more cloud ticks; level 2-3 of them if possible else hold points.
If stuck on Boss Wave and unable to reach level 15 upgrade Stormcaller.
Stormcaller by the portal gives extra damage to mobs below 60% HP which can save time; or take more crit.
At the end it is a gamble whether Stop Right There holds mobs in the poison clouds; run ended around Wave 100.
Reaching Wave 100 with a character without maxed towers is really good; retry later with maxed towers.
Atom Collider bonuses can give basically 100% more damage over time allowing more waves to be completed.
